subject.title: fix(ci): bound Opengrep installer fetch with connect timeout

question: Should the OpenGrep installer fail after a 30-second connection attempt or 120-second total transfer in both security workflows?
rationale: The implementation is technically correct, but selecting when a security scan should fail during a prolonged GitHub raw-content outage is an operational policy choice for the workflow owner.

options.title: Accept the proposed bounds
options.body: Use 30 seconds for connection establishment and 120 seconds overall, giving a small pinned script ample normal transfer time while bounding runner occupancy.

options.title: Choose different thresholds
options.body: Adjust both workflows and the guard together if security CI should tolerate a longer or shorter raw-content outage.

recommendation.title: Accept the proposed bounds
recommendation.body: Use 30 seconds for connection establishment and 120 seconds overall, giving a small pinned script ample normal transfer time while bounding runner occupancy.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced and documented the two OpenGrep workflow operating modes affected by this timeout policy.
